messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + tail latency observed for inference paths in us-west-2a. Metric spike started ~5m ago. Currently 5xx ~11% across GPU pools. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

sre-maya: ack, I'm on it. checking dashboards and host-level nets.

ops-alex: seeing RX drop counters on nic for several g5 instances in us-west-2a, also ENI retransmit increases. Suspect host network QoS or hypervisor queue exhaustion.

eng-jorge: any recent deploys in that AZ?

ops-alex: no deploys, infra churn was minimal. Cloud-side metrics show ENI rx_queue_full events.

prod-evan: customer impact: a handful of Dedicated customers show request failures and increased latency; Hosted API p95 doubled. CS already getting inbound tickets.

cs-lee: confirm, just relayed an outage notice to a power user. They're seeing 502s and timeouts intermittently.

incident-bot: Severity: SEV2 (partial impact to production inference; customer-facing issues). Suggested runbooks: net-degrade-eval, cross-az-shift.

sre-maya: immediate plan: 1) reduce new traffic into affected AZ by shifting weight to us-west-2b/c 2) enable model-fallback for heavy requests 3) open AWS ticket for ENI rx drops 4) warm cache in target AZs.

eng-jorge: I can push the fallback config. We'll flip heavy models to quantized-small variant (model-x-quant) to lower memory and retry budget. That should reduce tail latency for retried requests.

ops-alex: executing traffic shift now. Using our traffic manager to move 70% away from us-west-2a. Command I'm running:

```
trafficctl reroute --from=us-west-2a --to=us-west-2b --percentage=70 --dry-run=false
```

ops-alex: applied. Backend metrics should reflect within 30s.

sre-maya: confirming decrease in incoming connections to us-west-2a. 5xx rate trending down from 11% -> 6% after partial shift. Continue to ramp to 90% if stable.

prod-evan: notify customers: posting brief update now. CS-lee, share the message copy?

cs-lee: posted to affected customers: "We're seeing an infrastructure networking issue affecting us-west-2a causing intermittent 502s and increased latency. We've shifted the majority of traffic to other AZs and are investigating with AWS. Temporary mitigation in place."

eng-jorge: rolling model fallback: updating policy to prefer model-x-quant for requests > 8k tokens and heavy batch routes. Patch applied to routing config.

ops-alex: AWS ticket opened, case# 1234567890. Shared graphs showing ENI rx_queue_full and instance-level RX drops. AWS assigned an engineer. aws-support-bot: acknowledged, AWS investigating host-level NIC drops; asking for pcap and instance ids.

sre-maya: collecting pcap + instance ids and sending via AWS support console. Also spinning up two extra GPU nodes in us-west-2b to absorb shifted traffic: `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deployment/gpu-pool-usw2b -n inference`

incident-bot: Reminder: reduce DNS TTLs for service endpoints if you plan longer steering. Current TTL is 60s.

ops-alex: lowered TTL to 15s for control-plane LB.

sre-maya: monitoring kvcache miss rates in us-west-2b — warming cache by replaying recent hot prefixes to avoid cold-start latency. Running a small replay job now.

eng-jorge: added retry-policy tweak: client retry window shortened and linear backoff to avoid amplifying queue pressure.

prod-evan: preparing incident notification for status page with summary and mitigation steps. Tagging as partial impact, ongoing.

cs-lee: pinged top affected customers with expected timeline of 1-2 hours while AWS investigates.

aws-support-bot: AWS update: seeing burst of rx_queue metrics on host hypervisor; performing host-level checks and may migrate instances. ETA unknown.

oncall-dan: I am taking over the pager in 10 minutes. Can someone drop a short handoff with current mitigation state?

sre-maya: handoff: traffic shifted 70% -> 90% to us-west-2b, model fallback in place, extra nodes scaled in target AZs, AWS engaged (case#1234567890), CS notified. Monitoring: 5xx down to ~3% overall, p95 still elevated for a small subset. Ops to continue until AWS confirms root cause.

oncall-dan: thanks — I’ve got it. I’ll keep watch and escalate to SEV1 procedures if errors > 10% again or if cross-AZ reroute doesn't hold.

incident-bot: Incident thread created for follow-up RCA ownership. Please file RCA ticket with logs and timeline once mitigations complete. :white_check_mark:

oncall-dan: closing immediate handoff — will post periodic updates every 30m or on significant changes.

sre-maya: noted. adding a short runbook entry for ENI rx_queue failures and a checklist to validate cross-AZ KV cache warming for future runs.

cs-lee: will keep CS looped and escalate if customers request faster updates.

eng-jorge: leaving a note to try an alternate NIC driver on repro hosts for future test.

aws-support-bot: AWS will update case if they perform instance migration or hypervisor remediation.

oncall-dan: last check before wrap: 5xx 3%, p95 trending down. Holding at reduced weight to us-west-2a. If stable for 1hr, we'll gradually restore weight.
